parsed.explanation: The combined regime layers a hostile federal gate on a division with the harshest facility law in the dossier. Federally, executive orders fix sex as binary, block X/mismatched passport markers (Supreme Court-allowed Nov 2025), and instruct officers to refuse cases where documents cast doubt on sex, with lifetime-fraud ineligibility considered; trans travellers report confiscated passports. In custody, a trans woman was held 24h in a men's ward after a restroom arrest, and immigration detainees report beatings, solitary and sexual abuse. The division criminalizes restroom use contrary to birth sex in government buildings AND private businesses (up to 1 year), universal and in force since 1 July 2026 with litigation unresolved; a 3-day minor-outing mandate burdens travelling families. No documented visitor violence campaign or execution; remedies are active but unproven.

entry_documents.exposure: Federal sex-binary order; X markers and non-birth-sex markers stopped Feb 2025 (SCOTUS-allowed Nov 2025); Feb 2025 cable tells officers to refuse cases where documents cast doubt on sex and to consider lifetime fraud ineligibility; travellers report passports confiscated/blocked; foreign advisories issued. Division X licence option may mismatch passport.
entry_documents.protection: Challenged in national courts; existing X passports valid to expiry; legal-aid FAQ on document rules; waivers exist for fraud findings and are never automatic.
entry_documents.interaction: Document/presentation mismatch at entry can escalate to refusal, detention, then birth-sex custody placement or immigration detention.

investigation_detention_custody.exposure: Trans woman arrested under bathroom law, handcuffed, held 24 hours in the men's ward; immigration custody reports of forced labour, beatings, solitary and severe sexual abuse of trans men; national corrections bureau mandates hair-cutting, hormone removal and psychiatric substitution for transgender inmates since 2026.
investigation_detention_custody.protection: Bathroom statute requires willful entry plus refusal to leave in at least one analogue; several executive orders blocked/enjoined; prisoners won hormone-therapy right via 2024 national ruling.
investigation_detention_custody.interaction: Facility criminalisation is the arrest gateway that places an outed visitor into birth-sex custody, where documented abuse follows.

federal_state_facilities.exposure: Universal tier-1 exposure: division's 1 July 2026 law criminalizes restroom/changing-room use contrary to birth sex in government buildings and public-facing private businesses (gas stations, restaurants, venues, hospitals), first offence up to 1 year; only such law reaching private businesses. Nationally 9+1 units ban identity-congruent facilities in all government buildings; 4 units criminalize in certain circumstances; 6 units reach private settings.
federal_state_facilities.protection: 29 units plus capital district lack mapped bans; 22 units plus DC bar gender-identity discrimination; division retains X licences; civil-rights suit filed 30 Apr 2026; possible 16 Jun 2026 judicial narrowing (status unknown).
federal_state_facilities.interaction: Federal custody and division facility law combine: the arrest produced men's-ward detention, and private-business reach means no venue is exempt for a visitor.

care_services.exposure: EO calling minors' care 'mutilation'; Oct 2025 proposed rule barring public-insurance reimbursement for under-18 care; DOJ subpoenaed 20+ hospitals for under-19 patient records; LGBTQ youth lifeline shut down; care banned in 27 units; division bars birth-certificate changes and (for schools/childcare/medical staff) mandates disclosing a trans minor's status to parents within 3 days.
care_services.protection: Challenges pending on the health rules; division's 2018 birth-certificate law was litigated with fees awarded; hormone therapy for prisoners restored by 2024 national ruling.
care_services.interaction: Emergency care in a hospital is both a facility-ban site and a disclosure site for a travelling minor, compounding outing risk.

threat_framing_law_enforcement.exposure: Federal EO directing police to investigate schools for 'gender ideology'; Dec 2025 DOJ reward memo and May 2026 counterterrorism strategy referencing 'radically pro-transgender' ideology; 'forbidden terms' purge; advocates describe early genocide stages; 66% public support for birth-sex markers and 69% for sex-based athletics.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.protection: Reward criterion expressly does not list the phrase; strategy states counterterrorism powers will not target mere disagreement; national employment-discrimination and hate-crime statutes remain in force.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.interaction: Official framing lowers the threshold for discretionary stops and second inspections where a document discrepancy already exists.

minors_guardians.exposure: Division's March 2026 law requires schools, childcare providers and medical professionals to disclose a trans minor's status to parents within 3 days; federal EO threatens criminal prosecution of teachers facilitating social transition; 2022 felony/life bill for parents taking children out for care (blocked in upper chamber); care bans and Oct 2025 insurance rule.
minors_guardians.protection: The 2022 parental bill failed; a pending 2024 binary-sex bill has not passed; litigation continues on minors'-care orders.
minors_guardians.interaction: A travelling family using any childcare or medical service triggers mandated disclosure, converting routine care into state-verified outing.

street_violence_police_response.exposure: Arrest and 24-hour men's-ward detention under the facility law; airport screening guides document invasive secondary screening and pat-downs risking outing; no state-specific data showing violence above the general homicide rate was found.
street_violence_police_response.protection: National hate-crime statute covers gender identity; 23 units cover gender identity in bias-motivated-violence statutes; no national sodomy law; the trespass trigger requires refusal to leave, not automatic arrest.
street_violence_police_response.interaction: Street-level contact is dominated by the facility statute rather than private violence, and custody placement follows the stop.

remedies_unknowns.exposure: Suit against the facility law pending and a possible June 2026 narrowing whose continuing effect is unknown; no enforcement record under the measure; unresolved misdemeanour/felony classification; 37 units lacked gender-identity bias statutes as of 2019; multiple orders in flux so exposure varies by travel date.
remedies_unknowns.protection: Active civil-rights litigation has blocked or enjoined several federal orders; legal-aid FAQ, equality and identity-document maps track rules; courts have previously awarded fees against the state.
remedies_unknowns.interaction: Remedies operate after arrest, not before it, so the pending challenge does not neutralise the in-force statute for a visitor now.

anchor_checks.comparison: Ostravia combines birth-sex prison placement with cross-dressing criminalisation limited to administrative buildings and slow remedies. This division's law is broader — reaching every private business a visitor enters — and federal custody adds documented abuse and men's-ward placement, so this case sits slightly below 0.25-C; both share tier-1 state-imposed exposure without credible execution.

Kestrel Isles offers only administrative secondary screening, refusal of entry and slow appeals with no custody harm. Here entry refusal carries a possible lifetime fraud finding, custody places trans women in men's wards, and restroom use is itself a crime; materially more severe, so well below 0.55.

Meridia trains border officers, permits matching markers, and provides counsel and compensation with only brief detention. This jurisdiction does the opposite: markers are locked, mismatch invites refusal, and facilities are criminalised. The gap is a full tier-plus, confirming placement far beneath 0.75.

parsed.synthesis: The traveller faces one system: a federal entry gate that freezes markers and invites refusal for any sex discrepancy, chained to a division statute that makes restroom use contrary to birth sex a misdemeanour in every public-facing venue including restaurants, gas stations and hospitals — an inescapable, universal exposure with no documented working remedy yet, since the April 2026 suit's outcome and any June 2026 narrowing are unknown. Discovery leads to birth-sex custody, and the one documented arrest ended with 24 hours in a men's ward; immigration custody separately records beatings and sexual abuse of trans men. For families, the division's 3-day minor-disclosure mandate converts care or childcare into state-verified outing. Active litigation and residual protections keep this above the 0.15 tier, but the in-force criminalisation plus custody pattern place it firmly at the bottom of High Risk.
